cards.front: Recall a key point about Surface Finishing & Treatment
cards.back: Heat treatment alters material properties through controlled heating and cooling cycles without changing the shape.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Surface Finishing & Treatment
cards.back: Annealing heats metal above its critical temperature then cools it slowly (in the furnace) to soften and increase ductility.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Surface Finishing & Treatment
cards.back: Hardening heats steel above its critical temperature then quenches rapidly (in water or oil) to produce a hard, brittle martensitic structure.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Surface Finishing & Treatment
cards.back: Tempering reheats hardened steel to a lower temperature then cools it; reduces brittleness while retaining most of the hardness.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Surface Finishing & Treatment
cards.back: Normalising heats steel then air-cools it to produce a uniform, fine grain structure; relieves internal stresses from working.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Surface Finishing & Treatment
cards.back: Electroplating deposits a thin layer of metal (chromium, nickel, zinc, gold) on a component using an electric current in a solution.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Surface Finishing & Treatment
cards.back: Galvanising coats steel with a zinc layer by dipping in molten zinc at approximately 450 degrees C; excellent corrosion protection.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Surface Finishing & Treatment
cards.back: Painting and powder coating provide decorative and protective surface finishes; powder coating is more durable for engineering components.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Surface Finishing & Treatment
cards.back: Dip coating (plastic dipping) coats metal with a polymer layer for insulation, grip or corrosion protection.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Surface Finishing & Treatment
cards.back: Polishing improves surface smoothness and appearance; reduces friction and improves corrosion resistance by eliminating surface defects.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Surface Finishing & Treatment
cards.back: Surface finish is measured in micrometres (Ra value); smoother finishes reduce friction and improve fatigue life.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Surface Finishing & Treatment
cards.back: The choice of surface treatment depends on: required properties (hardness, corrosion resistance, appearance), cost, and operating environment.

cards.back: 1. For Surface Finishing & Treatment questions, use precise design and technology terminology 2. Consider function, aesthetics, ergonomics, sustainability and cost in your answers 3.
